div.style: color: rgb(31, 60, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Consent lives on the beneficiary side (accepts_sponsorship?), not on
what the sponsor can see. This replaced the old model where any
community visible under CommunityPolicy::Scope could appear as a
billing-takeover candidate — sponsorship is now opt-in by the
beneficiary and never reassigns Subscription ownership.

span.p:
Sponsorship#create
(SponsorshipPolicy#create? — sponsor must be self or a community they steward)

contributions now credit beneficiary's balance

Either party can end an active sponsorship
(SponsorshipPolicy#end?)
